notes.title: OrePlant CBT Tester Recruitment Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Hypercent, the developer of OrePlant!
Ahead of the official demo release in October, we are recruiting testers to experience the game early through our Closed Beta Test (CBT).

[h3]CBT Schedule[/h3]
[list]
[*] CBT Tester Recruitment Period: Until September 18 (Thu), 14:59 UTC
[*] CBT Key Distribution: Sequential distribution starting September 19 (Fri), 06:00 UTC
[*] CBT Ends: October 2 (Thu), 06:00 UTC (approximately 2 weeks)
[/list]
※ The CBT will be available only from the key distribution date until the end date.

[h3]How to Participate[/h3]
[url=https://forms.gle/jZUTjv3hKDNVNcM87]Apply via Google Form[/url]
[list]
[*] Selected participants will receive a CBT key via email.
[*] Register the key on Steam to access and play the beta version immediately!
[/list]

[h3]Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You are free to share videos, screenshots, and impressions, but please refrain from revealing the main story ending or major cutscenes.  
[*] Participation in the feedback survey during the CBT period would be greatly appreciated, as it will help us improve the game.  
[*] Please note that as this is a development build, some bugs or unfinished elements may be present.  
[/list]

Your valuable participation and feedback will help make OrePlant a more enjoyable and polished experience.  
We sincerely look forward to your interest and support!
